notes: Part3 native repair of source ID 34. Bánh 3 tầng ghép từ thanh, nến là thanh có ngọn lửa vòng, hoa trang trí là chuỗi vòng trong từng tầng, 2 bóng bay hai bên. R1 enlarged from 0.6875 to .85 units to make the small eye/flame legible with native authoring geometry. R2 enlarged from 0.6875 to .85 units to make the small eye/flame legible with native authoring geometry. R3 enlarged from 0.6875 to .85 units to make the small eye/flame legible with native authoring geometry. Removed unproven picture-only Bomb and drawing arms; no Booster/Chain. Balloon strings have horizontal neck segments at pin contacts and no redundant Guides. Figure silhouette is a design reference, not evidence of difficulty or necessary cross-object preparation for every bar. No campaign import.
